name: majors-funding-unwind
why: Five of nine crypto-major agents are barren and three of four traders lose, while frequent bars-only reversion is structurally challenged by fees. Current runtime capabilities confirm backfilled, point-in-time BTC and ETH settled funding history. Test whether unusually negative funding conditions a short-crowding unwind after a recent decline and completed-hour stabilization; spot receives no funding and the proposed edge is unmeasured. Use one passive venue-minimum exposure of approximately $10, with at most one quantity-step rounding allowance, binding cash and House limits, one submission per funding observation, managed bid expiry, a fee-aware profit hurdle, an observed price stop and a 36-hour exit. Preserve crypto-reversion attribution and applicable selection history. This unexecuted candidate starts at rung 0 and requires sufficient after-cost replay, applicable holdout, independent paper observations, audit and ordinary capital qualification. Reject sparse activity, adverse-selected fills or negative economics rather than forcing turnover.
